code.provenance_limit: Earlier commands honestly recorded dirty=true. Their HEAD is not claimed to be an exact source snapshot; the final implementation diff and source hashes are archived here.

official_checkpoint.published_spatial_training_profile: varied, non-square; no verified 1080p training claim

upstream_findings.A_model: OursDiscreteVideoTokenizer and official config retained. Checkpoint loads all learned parameters; omitted fixed FSQ/patch buffers are not treated as missing learned weights.
upstream_findings.B_backbone: Factorized 4x8x8 causal convolution encoder and decoder are reused as objects. CHP replaces their spatial attention with bounded 16x16 windows; this is an architecture change.
upstream_findings.C_vit: vit_encode/vit_decode keep dense time/space organization and global block-causal attention. The old ViT path is excluded only from the separately configured CHP model, not deleted upstream.
upstream_findings.D_masks: adaptive_tokenize/mask_tokens zero continuous dense positions. MSE ordering requires position metadata. These masked latents are not the CHP integer prefix stream.
upstream_findings.E_FSQ: Exact upstream FSQuantizer with 64000 symbols and bidirectional index/code mapping; no 8192/13-bit assumption.
upstream_findings.F_latents: Original reshaped dense 2D latents differ from new fixed learned 1D slots. Missing slots have an independent mask/embedding; slot order is deterministic geometry, with no full ordering table on the wire.
upstream_findings.G_attention: Original block mask marks future blocks as forbidden. SDPA boolean masks mark allowed positions True. The optimized temporal block uses causal SDPA; cache offset masking is explicit.
upstream_findings.H_checkpoint: Flex model card reports 81-frame windows at varied non-square resolutions. Config label 256p is not evidence of native 1080p training. Original ViT spatial rotary tables are 96x96 and temporal embeddings have 49 positions.
upstream_findings.I_gradients: Frozen encoder may use no_grad. Frozen decoder does not: RGB gradients reach new latent recovery modules. Native checkpoint on/off gradient equality is measured; finite nonzero training gradients are logged.
upstream_findings.J_streaming: Original video_lib/video_cli use window execution and overlap; ViT cache implementation is commented out. CHP implements actual per-module convolution/phase/bootstrap/pooling/upsample/KV state. Recomputed history and reused caches have independent measurements.
upstream_findings.normalization: Actual factorized backbone CausalNormalize uses num_groups=1 and time2batch GroupNorm. Its implementation and pretrained normalization semantics are unchanged.

geometry.temporal_protocol: one bootstrap + four 4-frame blocks; explicit EOS valid tail
